result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password**\. It's a particularly good balance of security, ease of use, and team management.

However, **Bitwarden** is arguably the better choice if keeping costs down is a priority.

Here are the options I'd shortlist for a small business in 2026.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall)

Approx. \$8.99/user/month

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Admin controls, access management and reporting.
- Good for teams with mixed technical abilities.
  
  Best when simplicity and adoption matter.
  
  [1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

Approx. \$4/user/month

- Open-source core.
- Shared collections and team vaults.
- Admin and audit features.
- Good value for technically comfortable teams.
  
  Best when cost and flexibility matter.
  
  [Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

Approx. \$2–4/user/month for entry-level plans

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared folders and secure credential sharing.
- Useful security and compliance capabilities.
  
  Best for teams needing structured access controls.
  
  [Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Proton Pass Plus - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ieWxaf1V1oKwR5RRYZyCUPTssuPFmf3KGImAFxDImLo918b9HrqSkmcFxYOmTtZlPSYlBfMDN2fRfrT9cxgSPcskegAU9CMbarL_OHz9CIE3qqDdr6RF19eJVNxO2Ol4ntEKr3D7ZAQzGf8y8YfFA_bGj9p5D2RwqWU6uGCUEvGwoAX0vUa7O4BZUHkNpExF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

From approximately \$1.99/user/month

- Privacy-focused approach.
- Encrypted sharing.
- Useful alias and email privacy features.
  
  Best for privacy-conscious, budget-conscious teams.
  
  [Proton Pass business plans](https://proton.me/business/pass)

## My comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden | Keeper | Proton |
|--------|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Good | Good | Good |
| Shared passwords | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good | Excellent | Good |
| Audit capabilities | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| SSO / provisioning | Yes | Higher tiers | Higher tiers | Plan-dependent |
| Value for money | Good | Excellent | Very good | Excellent |


## What I'd look for in a team password manager

Regardless of which one you choose, make sure it supports\:

1. **Shared vaults\:** Share company logins without sending passwords through Slack or email.
2. **Individual accounts\:** Every employee has their own account.
3. **Access revocation\:** Instantly remove access when someone leaves.
4. **Role-based permissions\:** Not everyone should have access to every password.
5. **Two-factor authentication\:** Protect employee accounts.
6. **Audit logs\:** Know who accessed or changed shared credentials.

## My recommendation

- 2–10 people: 1Password Teams Starter Pack or Bitwarden Teams.
- 10–30 people: 1Password Business or Bitwarden Teams.
- Cost-sensitive or technical team: Bitwarden.
- Privacy-first organisation: Proton Pass.
